Record Class McpDesignHandoff

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.mcp.McpDesignHandoff
Record Components:
schemaVersion - handoff schema
status - ready, blocked, or error
message - human-readable status
unmetConditions - blockers when status is not ready
scenarios - scenario titles extracted from accepted Gherkin
acceptanceCriteria - AC IDs traced from coverage / tags
examples - example-table rows (headers + cells) when present
gapMap - fluent gap-map step classifications
oracles - evidence oracles from analysis
optionalUrl - caller-supplied URL; never invented
automationPrefill - typed prefill map for Automation canvas (intent/oracles/data)
wroteFiles - always false
public record McpDesignHandoff(String schemaVersion, String status, String message, List<String> unmetConditions, List<String> scenarios, List<String> acceptanceCriteria, List<Map<String,String>> examples, List<McpDesignGapMapStep> gapMap, List<McpDesignOracle> oracles, String optionalUrl, Map<String,String> automationPrefill, boolean wroteFiles) extends Record
Design→Automation handoff pack (issue #5956). Never writes Java, locators, or repository files.
